question.question_text: Which activity took longer, handling the dough mixer and organizing the workspace or engaging with the coal burner?

answer_options.text: Handling the dough mixer and organizing the workspace took longer
Organizing the workspace took more time than engaging with the coal burner
Engaging with the coal burner took longer
Both activities took the same amount of time
The coal burner required minimal engagement, thus was quicker
